summary: This bill increases tax credits for very small businesses that offer retirement plans to their employees and allows companies that help small businesses set up these plans to claim the tax credit directly, provided they reduce their fees to the small business by the credit amount.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to provide tax credits for microemployers establishing pension plans and allows for the assignment of these credits to service providers. This directly impacts tax liabilities by creating new credits, effectively lowering taxes for eligible entities.

The bill creates new tax credits (expanded startup credit for microemployers and assignable credits to service providers) under IRC section 45E. These provisions reduce federal revenue with no offsetting revenue raisers or spending cuts, directly increasing the deficit. The entire bill is devoted to expanding these tax expenditures.
